description: Protects repository routing for schema, FormData, Server Action, RPC, upload, Storage, webhook, payment, pure-SQL, and pure-UI boundaries while keeping physical references in the evaluated NSAZ bundle.

cases.title: Change an RPC and Server Action contract

executor_input.prompt: Identify every applicable repo-local skill before changing the payment RPC arguments, Server Action wrapper, and concurrency tests.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The response routes nextjs-server-action-zod, supabase-safe-migration, test-quality-strategy, and code-commenting-and-maintainability while preserving the application contract versus database invariant boundary.

expected_behavior: A migrated NSAZ candidate selects references/server-actions-and-route-handlers.md, references/schema-placement-and-design.md, and references/validation-test-matrix.md and skips references/formdata-and-react-hook-form.md and references/uploads-webhooks-and-payments.md. Physical obligations remain NSAZ-owned; routed skills add no cross-bundle reference expectations. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Omit the database or test owner, omit eligible test-file documentation, or move the persisted-state rule into Zod.
